column1: # Each test unit of geom-test, geom-fuzz and geom-gen with its seconds under wasmtime on
# wasm32-wasip1, in debug: the most that `cargo test` took to run it (wasmtime compiling the binary
# included) in kernel-dev.yml's wasm job on main's pushes 79dd48d74, baaea2828, e792e882e and
# whole run 1,327 s). `kernel-quality wasm-dev-parts` shares the units out among the job's parts by
# these seconds, and geom-test's tests/wasm_dev_parts.rs holds the job to that plan and every unit
# to exactly one part. A unit is `lib` (the library's unit tests), `doc` (its doctests), `bin <name>`
# or `test <name>`; a unit not listed here is planned at the slowest listed time. Two units of one
# name in two crates (`test naming`, `test orient2d`) cannot be told apart in the logs, so both carry
# `test certificates_workflow` came after those pushes: its seconds are the same job's on the head
# of the pull request that added it (run 44086231115).
# `test solidcore_job` is not measured yet: it carries the slowest listed time, as the rule above
# plans an unlisted unit, until the wasm job has run on it.
